title: Basement albums that they can't sell...
text:
I thought it was a cool idea, help build my collection.
But if your into vinyl at all, you most likely have the albums they send out...
I've gotten six albums so far, rolling stones greatest hits, creedence Clearwater greatest hits (who I personally despise) I mean really? Stuff that I wouldn't buy on my own.
I wish they sent me some pink Floyd, or some doors, I dunno, felt like they randomly picked albums out of the pile they couldn't sell.
And for the price of vinyl these days, I would think maybe cutting down the price due to it being a subscription.
But you still pay $25 and change for an album that you might not actually want.
So then the trouble of returning it.
It looks good on paper, but the cost is the same as picking out what you actually want
Maybe a small questionnaire about the style you like? Bands you like? Curate a list of similar?
Could be better, but I'd suggest just buying your own unless they cut the price by like %25 to make it worth actually subscribing.
label: negative
